regions.summary: Code in CsJoyMergeBits, CsJoyStrobeRead, CsReadJoypadsAlt

units.name: CsReadJoypadsAlt
units.summary: Self-contained controller read in the cutscene bank: strobe and read both pads (CsJoyStrobeRead), merge the expansion-port bits (CsJoyMergeBits), then turn JoyPressed into new presses and JoyHeld into the held state. Same algorithm as ReadJoypadsRaw/ReadJoypads in the fixed bank, but it uses CsJoyEx

units.name: CsJoyStrobeRead
units.summary: Write CsJoyStrobeBase+1 then CsJoyStrobeBase to JOY1 (with the base at 0 this is the ordinary 1-then-0 strobe), then shift 8 bits of each pad into JoyPressed/JoyPressed+1 and the expansion bits into CsJoyExpBits1/2.

units.name: CsJoyMergeBits
units.summary: OR the expansion-port bits (CsJoyExpBits1/2) into JoyPressed/JoyPressed+1.

units.name: Cs5_SetBlackPalette
units.summary: Set the whole cutscene palette to black, queue it and fade out.

units.name: CsScene_Stage4Intro

units.name: CsScene_Stage5Intro
units.summary: Scene 4: stage intro with moving sprite groups (Cs5_Scene4Anim).

units.name: Cs5_Scene4Anim
units.summary: Scene 4: metasprite number $20-$25 for the walking figure, chosen by its X position (CsSpriteRecs) in $20-pixel bands.

units.name: Cs5_Scene4Move
units.summary: Scene 4 part 2, first movement: figure walks left (and slowly down); returns its metasprite ($27-$29). At X = 0 it holds a pose, waits $80 frames and switches Cs5_Scene4Phase to the second movement.

units.name: Cs5_Scene4Move2
units.summary: Scene 4 part 2, second movement: figure walks right until X = $70; returns its metasprite ($2A-$2C).

units.name: CsScene_FinalIntro
units.summary: Scene 5: intro before the final area.

units.name: CsScene_Ending
units.summary: Scene 6: the ending. Multi-part sequence (Cs5_EndingFigureFrame), then the staff credits text ($AF00 area) and return to the title.

units.name: Cs5_EndingFigureFrame
units.summary: Ending shot 3: metasprite for the figure by animation phase ObjAux+5 ($18, $19, $1A, then $1B sliding right via Cs5_EndingFigureSlide); kept in CsEndingSprite.

units.name: Cs5_EndingFigureSlide
units.summary: Final phase of shot 3: metasprite $1B moving right one pixel per call up to X = $C8.

units.name: Cs5_EndingStep
units.summary: Queue the next 14-byte row of the ending story text (Cs5_EndingData) into the nametable not being shown; when all rows are out ($8C bytes) it abandons the caller's loop and goes to the credits.

units.name: Cs5_EndingScroll2
units.summary: Scroll the story text 15 pixels per frame; while scrolling it re-enters the caller's loop without a new text row. When the scroll reaches 255 it flips the nametable and waits $C0 frames, then returns so the next row is drawn.

units.name: ObjFaceBatman
units.summary: Build ObjDirFlags from Batman's position relative to the object: bit7 = Batman is to the left, bit6 = Batman is above, bit0 = Batman is more than about $60 pixels away horizontally.

units.name: ObjMove
units.summary: Move the object by ObjDeltaX (if ObjDirFlags bit5; bit7 = leftwards) and ObjDeltaY (if bit4; bit6 = upwards). Y wraps inside 240-line rows.

units.name: ObjProbeTerrain
units.summary: Terrain at the object position offset by ObjDeltaX (direction from ObjDirFlags bit7) and ObjDeltaY (bit6 = above); returns the CollisionAtPoint result in A / TerrainResult.

units.name: ObjPlaceSprite
units.summary: Sprite draw origin = logical position - (ObjDeltaX, ObjDeltaY), with Y row wrapping. Called at the end of almost every handler.

units.name: ObjScreenOffset
units.summary: ObjDeltaX = high byte of (object X - camera X); when zero, ObjDeltaX instead receives the vertical difference (object Y - camera Y) row part. Non-zero means the object is outside the visible screen.

units.name: SetPrgBanks
units.summary: Map PRG banks: A -> MMC3 R6 ($8000 window), X -> R7 ($A000 window). Values are register values (bank+$10, MMC3 masks them mod 16). NmiSync bit6 marks the switch as in progress; the NMI clears that bit when it had to remap banks itself, so the loop repeats the writes. If the NMI changed the CHR R2/R3

units.name: WaitForNmi
units.summary: Set NmiSync bit7 and spin until the NMI handler clears it, then clear the +32 VRAM-increment bit in the PPUCTRL shadow.

units.name: FetchInlineWord
units.summary: Helper for routines that take a 2-byte inline argument after their JSR. It reads the caller's return address two stack levels up ($0103/$0104), loads the word that follows the JSR into Ptr0 ($00/$01) and advances that return address by 2 so execution resumes after the argument.

units.name: FlushPpuBuffer
units.summary: Called from NMI. Copies the PpuBuf queue to VRAM: each record is [addr hi, addr lo, count, data...]; a byte >= $80 ends the queue. After palette writes ($3Fxx) the PPU address is reset to $0000 to avoid palette-corruption glitches. Resets PpuBufIndex afterwards.

units.name: QueuePpuRow
units.summary: Queue VRAM data: A = VRAM address hi, X = address lo, Y = byte count, and an inline word after the JSR points at the source bytes. Appends one record to PpuBuf. Returns A=1 if the queue overflowed (the partial record is dropped by PpuBufAdvance). QueuePpuBlock ($C502) is a second entry that queues s

phase1.evidence: Static: QueuePpuRow alternate entry $C502 (bank 14 fixed $C000): stores X/A to $02/$03, calls inline-argument helper $C48D, decodes contiguously and falls into observed code at $C517 on an instruction boundary (lead L-008, redirect r1-a1).

regions.summary: Code in QueuePpuBlock

units.name: QueuePpuBlock
units.summary: Queue a block of VRAM rows: A = VRAM address hi, X = lo, and an inline word after the JSR points at the source. Its first byte packs the row count (high nibble) and row length (low nibble); each row becomes one PpuBuf record, 32 bytes further down the nametable. Shares the row loop with QueuePpuRow.

units.name: PpuBufAdvance
units.summary: Advance X in PpuBuf; on hitting PpuBufLimit terminate the queue, discard this return address (abort the caller's record) and return A=1.

units.name: FillPages
units.summary: Fill whole 256-byte RAM pages with A, from page Y down to page X.

units.name: JumpTableDispatch
units.summary: Jump engine: JSR here with A = index; the word table follows the JSR. The return address is popped (it points at the table - 1) and control jumps through Ptr0 to entry A. Does not return to the caller.

units.name: ReadJoypadsRaw
units.summary: Strobe and read both controllers (standard + expansion bit) into JoyPressed/JoyPressed+1 (temporarily raw state).

units.summary: Read the pads until two consecutive reads agree (DPCM read glitch workaround), then derive JoyPressed (new presses) and JoyHeld.

units.name: RequestSound
units.summary: Request sound effect / music A: stored in SoundRequest with the pending bit (bit6) set in SoundReqFlags; the sound driver consumes it.

units.name: JumpToDrawBatman
units.summary: Map bank 6 at $8000 (keeping $A000) and jump to DrawBatman ($9BB0). Entered by the JMP that ends CommitBatmanPosition (bank 4), so Batman's sprites are rebuilt every time his position is committed.
